{| class="wikitable skin-invert-image" style="float:right; margin-left:1em; width:160px"
|+ [[Orthographic projection]]<BR>in A<sub>8</sub> [[Coxeter plane]] 
|- align=center
|[[File:8-simplex_t0.svg|160px]]<BR>[[8-simplex]]<BR>{{CDD|node_1|3|node|3|node|3|node|3|node|3|node|3|node|3|node}}
|}
In 8-dimensional [[geometry]], there are 135 [[uniform 8-polytope|uniform polytopes]] with A<sub>8</sub> symmetry. There is one self-dual regular form, the [[8-simplex]] with 9 vertices.

Each can be visualized as symmetric [[orthographic projection]]s in [[Coxeter plane]]s of the A<sub>8</sub> Coxeter group, and other subgroups.

== Graphs ==
Symmetric [[orthographic projection]]s of these 135 polytopes can be made in the A<sub>8</sub>, A<sub>7</sub>, A<sub>6</sub>, A<sub>5</sub>, A<sub>4</sub>, A<sub>3</sub>, A<sub>2</sub> [[Coxeter plane]]s. A<sub>''k''</sub> has [''k''+1] symmetry.

Each of these 135 polytopes is shown in these 7 symmetry planes, with vertices and edges drawn, and vertices colored by the number of overlapping vertices in each projective position in progressive order: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, magenta, red-violet.
